title: Bay Topology Entry
description: One bay of a station's physical topology: its ordinal and the program ordinals that bay can run. This is the unit the station re-declares in every BootNotification (bays[]) and the unit the server echoes in a 3018 TOPOLOGY_MISMATCH `details` object. Labels are NOT part of it -- they are descriptive and are never compared.

bayNumber.description: The station-assigned ordinal identifying this bay physically, as declared at provisioning. Unique within the message. The set need NOT be dense.

programNumbers.description: The programNumber of every program this bay has, as declared at provisioning. Ordinals only. Order carries no meaning; the server compares this as a SET. The set need NOT be dense.
